import gdsfactory as gf

r = gf.Component()

mmi_splitter1 = r.add_ref(gf.components.mmi1x2())
mmi_splitter1.move((0, 0))

phase_shifter = r.add_ref(gf.components.straight_heater_metal(length=10.0))
phase_shifter.move((100, 0))

mmi_splitter2 = r.add_ref(gf.components.mmi1x2())
mmi_splitter2.0)
mmi_splitter2.move((250, 0))

gf.routing.route_single(
    r,
    mmi_splitter1.ports['o1'],
    phase_shifter.ports['o1'],
    cross_section='strip',
    radius=15
)

gf.routing.route_bundle(
    r,
    [mmi_splitter1.ports['o2'], mmi_splitter1.ports['o3']],
    [phase_shifter.ports['o1'], phase_shifter.ports['o1']],
    cross_section='strip',
    radius=15,
    separation=15
)

gf.routing.route_bundle(
    r,
    [phase_shifter.ports['o2']],
    [mmi_splitter2.ports['o1']],
    cross_section='strip',
    radius=15
)

gf.routing.route_bundle(
    r,
    [mmi_splitter2.ports['o2'], mmi_splitter2.ports['o3']],
    [phase_shifter.ports['o2'], phase_shifter.ports['o2']],
    cross_section='strip',
    radius=15,
    separation=15
)

r.add_port('o1', port=mmi_splitter1.ports['o1'])
r.add_port('o2', port=mmi_splitter2.ports['o3'])

r.draw_ports()
r.plot()
